_note: The Manchester United poster tiles shown on /posters/ (scripts/build-posters-page.mjs). One tile per poster still on sale. `url` is where the tile links: the four final posters redrawn with the skyline art (25 Nov 2026) are sold on https://shop.thearchv.ca and link to their product pages there, with the shop's own product photo at 900x675 under public/shop/ Nothing else is on sale: the five Manchester United Women Etsy listings were already unavailable on Etsy on 25 Nov 2026 (checked in a browser), so their tiles went too. `listing` is the Etsy listing id the tile was first made from. Fourteen Etsy listings were deactivated on 25 Nov 2026 and their tiles removed with the women's five; never add a tile whose link is not live. Keep in step with src/data/posters.ts (the app's poster feed). The front page no longer reads this file: its tiles are the seasonal shop range in scripts/data/seasonal-tiles.json. `art` (gap4-5, 2026-11-15) records what the printed artwork itself carries, read off the file under public/posters/: every club name, every player name on a shirt or the goal timeline, and the quoted headline line (null when the poster has none). It is a record for the founder's ruling on the match posters, which is still open (CLAUDE.md, The quote posters and the app storefront), not a clearance: `ruling` stays "pending" until he decides. Nothing renders it.
